terms.definition: The rate of flow of charge, I = ΔQ/Δt.
The work done (energy transferred) per unit charge between two points, V = W/Q.
terms.examiner: The volt is one joule per coulomb.

terms.definition: Potential difference divided by current, R = V/I.
terms.examiner: The ohm is one volt per ampere.

terms.definition: For an ohmic conductor at constant temperature, current is directly proportional to potential difference.
ρ = RA/L: the resistance of a 1 m length of material with a 1 m² cross-sectional area.
terms.examiner: Unit Ω m. It depends on the material and temperature, not the dimensions.

terms.definition: A material whose resistivity becomes zero below its critical temperature.
terms.examiner: Uses: strong magnetic fields, power cables with no energy loss.
